blocks.title: Lights, Camera, Action!
blocks.body: What are you doing right now? Sitting? Reading? Those are actions!

blocks.question: What do we call an action word?
blocks.explanation: A verb is an action word!

blocks.back: An action you can do (Run, Jump, Eat).

blocks.title: Examples of Verbs
blocks.body:
I **run** in the park.
She **reads** a book.
The dog **barks**.

blocks.question: Which of these is a verb?
blocks.explanation: You can jump! It's an action.

blocks.title: The Action Test
blocks.body: To check if a word is a verb, ask: 'Can I do it?' Can you 'Tree'? No. Can you 'Run'? Yes!

blocks.title: Verbs in sentences
blocks.body: Every complete sentence must have a verb!

blocks.question: Find the verb: 'Ravi drinks milk.'
blocks.explanation: 'Drinks' is the action Ravi is doing!
